title: A1 Final Review Part 2: Present Cont & Past Simple
completion_message: ¡Excelente! Has superado con éxito la segunda parte del Gran Repaso Final de A1.

stages.title: Gran Repaso: Present Cont y Past Simple

parts.visual: Present Continuous: Acciones ocurriendo AHORA o planes fijos a futuro. Estructura: To Be + verbo(-ing). I am working right now. We are launching tomorrow. Negativo: I'm not working. Pregunta: Are you working?
parts.audio: Present Continuous for actions happening NOW or fixed future plans. Structure: To Be plus I-N-G verb. I am working right now. We are launching tomorrow. Negative: I am not working. Question: Are you working?

parts.visual: Past Simple: Acciones TERMINADAS en un tiempo específico del pasado. Verbos regulares terminan en -ed (worked), irregulares cambian (went). Negativo: didn't + verbo original (I didn't work). Pregunta: Did you + verbo original? (Did you work?).
parts.audio: Past Simple for FINISHED actions at a specific time in the past. Regular verbs end in E-D, like worked. Irregular verbs change, like went. Negative: didn't plus the original verb. Question: Did you plus the original verb.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige la forma correcta del Present Continuous o Past Simple.

questions.question: I ____ a very important report right now. (Estoy escribiendo).
questions.explanation: Con 'right now' usamos Present Continuous: am writing.

questions.question: She ____ to New York tomorrow morning. (Plan fijo: va a viajar).
questions.explanation: Present Continuous también se usa para planes futuros confirmados: is traveling.

questions.question: ____ they working on the project at the moment?
questions.explanation: Pregunta de Present Continuous: Are they working...?

questions.question: We ____ using that software anymore. (Ya no estamos usando).
questions.explanation: Negativo del Present Continuous para 'we' es aren't.

questions.question: I ____ the client yesterday morning. (Llamé).
questions.explanation: Acción terminada en el pasado ('yesterday') usa Past Simple: called.

questions.question: The company ____ a new product last year. (Lanzó).
questions.explanation: Acción terminada ('last year') = Past Simple: launched.

questions.question: ____ you attend the meeting yesterday?
questions.explanation: Pregunta en Past Simple usa el auxiliar 'Did'.

questions.question: We ____ receive the email yesterday. (No recibimos).
I didn't ____ the document. (Imprimir).
questions.explanation: Después de 'didn't', el verbo vuelve a su forma original: print.

questions.question: Did she ____ the contract? (Firmar).
questions.explanation: Después de 'Did', el verbo va en su forma original: sign.

questions.question: They ____ to the conference two days ago. (Fueron).
What ____ you doing right now?
questions.explanation: Present Continuous: What are you doing...?

questions.question: I ____ to the manager an hour ago. (Hablé).
He ____ fixing the server at this moment. (Está).
____ she travel to Paris last week?
questions.explanation: Pregunta en pasado (last week): Did she travel...?

questions.question: The CEO is ____ a speech right now. (Dando).
They didn't ____ my call. (Responder).
questions.explanation: Después de didn't, verbo base: answer.

questions.question: Are you ____ to the presentation tomorrow? (Plan futuro: ¿Vas a ir?).
questions.explanation: Present Continuous para futuro: Are you going...?

questions.question: I ____ tired yesterday. (Estaba).
questions.explanation: Pasado del verbo To Be (I): was.

stages.title: Written Expression
stages.description: Escribe la respuesta correcta (am, is, are, did, didn't o el verbo en pasado).

questions.question: I ____ writing an email right now. (Estoy)
She ____ traveling to NY tomorrow. (Está - plan futuro)
They ____ to the conference. (go - pasado irregular)
Did she ____ the contract? (sign - después de did)
I didn't ____ the document. (print - después de didn't)
I ____ tired yesterday. (Estaba - pasado de am)

stages.title: Listening Comprehension
stages.description: Escucha y selecciona la frase exacta.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: I am writing a very important report right now.
options: I am writing a very important report right now.
I am reading a very important report right now.
I wrote a very important report right now.
I write a very important report right now.
questions.correct_answer: I am writing a very important report right now.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: She is traveling to New York tomorrow.
options: She is traveling to New York tomorrow.
She traveled to New York tomorrow.
He is traveling to New York tomorrow.
She is flying to New York tomorrow.
questions.correct_answer: She is traveling to New York tomorrow.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: Are they working on the project at the moment?
options: Are they working on the project at the moment?
Are you working on the project at the moment?
Is he working on the project at the moment?
Were they working on the project at the moment?
questions.correct_answer: Are they working on the project at the moment?

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: I called the client yesterday morning.
options: I called the client yesterday morning.
I called the client yesterday afternoon.
I call the client yesterday morning.
She called the client yesterday morning.
questions.correct_answer: I called the client yesterday morning.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: The company launched a new product last year.
options: The company launched a new product last year.
The company launched a new product last month.
The company launches a new product last year.
We launched a new product last year.
questions.correct_answer: The company launched a new product last year.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: Did you attend the meeting yesterday?
options: Did you attend the meeting yesterday?
Did he attend the meeting yesterday?
Do you attend the meeting yesterday?
Did you go to the meeting yesterday?
questions.correct_answer: Did you attend the meeting yesterday?

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: They went to the conference two days ago.
options: They went to the conference two days ago.
They go to the conference two days ago.
We went to the conference two days ago.
They traveled to the conference two days ago.
questions.correct_answer: They went to the conference two days ago.
